systemfields.description: Split and offset mesh polys with random value making them to catch plesant highlight. Userful for mimiking solar or other panels.

tags.script_action_help:
Select a primitive in the Scene Viewer or Scene Graph Tree pane.
Ctrl-click to select using the primitive picker dialog.
Alt-click to toggle movement of the display flag.

tags.script_callback:
import loputils
node = kwargs['node']
file = None
if node.evalParm('reftype') == 'reffile':
    file = node.parm('reffilepath').evalAsString().strip('\'"')
loputils.initializeParameters(node, kwargs['script_value'], file)

tags.script_action:
import loputils
node = kwargs['node']
if node.evalParm('reftype') != 'reffile':
    loputils.selectPrimsInParm(kwargs, True)
else:
    file = node.parm('reffilepath').evalAsString().strip('\'"')
    prims = loputils.selectPrimsInParmFromFile(kwargs, False, file)
tags.script_action_help:
Select primitives in the Scene Viewer or Scene Graph Tree pane.
Ctrl-click to select using the primitive picker dialog.
Shift-click to select using the primitive pattern editor.
Alt-click to toggle movement of the display flag.
